question: Citizens Bank quarterly call-report data: citizens_bank_full_financials.csv reports INTINC (year-to-date interest income) and citizens_bank_financials.csv reports ASSET at each REPDTE. Take INTINC at REPDTE 20221231 (the full-year 2022 figure) and divide it by the simple average of ASSET at the four quarter-ends 20220331, 20220630, 20220930 and 20221231. Express as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
f=pd.read_csv(D+'/citizens_bank_financials.csv');g=pd.read_csv(D+'/citizens_bank_full_financials.csv')
i=g[g.REPDTE==20221231].INTINC.iloc[0];a=f[f.REPDTE.isin([20220331,20220630,20220930,20221231])].ASSET.mean();print(round(i/a*100,2))
